title: Ballot-layer verdict/finding coherence: an APPROVE ballot may not cite an OPEN blocking finding it raised itself
objective: Close #211. `validate_verification_record` accepted a ballot whose verdict contradicted its own cited findings -- flipping the PR-196 record's ballot REJECT->APPROVE while it cites an OPEN MAJOR rendered BADF VERIFY PASS. The matrix layer already refuses a VERIFIED row over an OPEN blocking finding, and check_g08_binding (badf_gate.py:1742) refuses the shape on a review binding; the record's own ballot layer was unchecked. Additive refusal, no signature change.
business_value: The record is the artifact future tooling reads. QA's mitigations bound the blast radius -- an incoherent ballot cannot become authority or a green dossier -- but the record could carry a self-contradiction, and a reader downstream has no way to know the verdict and the findings disagree.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: validate_verification_record refuses a strict APPROVE ballot citing a finding in its own finding_ids that is OPEN and MAJOR+
tests/test_badf_verification_evidence.py: red-first refusal test, with APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS / REJECT / resolved-finding pinned as negative controls
out_of_scope: APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS condition-mapping (the filed criterion): the record schema carries NO condition structure and 0 of 5 encoded records use that verdict -- building it means inventing a schema field, which this issue's own scope forbids
the matrix layer and C6 at dossier level: both already refuse this shape
#218 (exactly-one-EXACT-registry-pin): tests-only and ladder-internal, dispatched as a separate WP -- folding it here would drag it into a contract_changed review round

synthesis-status governance (#271): a finding can be weakened outside the governed paths by editing status/severity directly -- withdrawn[] and downgraded[] are defined and never required. Pre-existing; declined on BARCHI-1's scope ruling and filed with QA's four probes. This control makes those paths CHEAPER (the honest encoding is now refused) without making them worse, which is the argument for closing #271 rather than for folding it here.
acceptance_criteria: The #211 probe (PR-196 record, verdict flipped to APPROVE, finding left OPEN/MAJOR) exits 1 with a message naming the ballot and the finding; it exited 0 PASS before
All five encoded verification records still VERIFY PASS -- the regression floor
APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS over an OPEN finding still passes: it is this module's baseline fixture and the designed conditional arc
Neutering the new raise turns tests/test_badf_verification_evidence red -- the control is watched, not a 13th unwatched control (#250)

The control's claim is scoped in-source: it enforces verdict/finding coherence GIVEN governed statuses; it reads status/severity from the record rather than corroborating them against synthesis.withdrawn[]/downgraded[], so it does not survive an ungoverned status edit (#271).
evidence: before: surface absent -> Ran 1 test OK in 0.005s (vacuous)
after: surface absent -> AssertionError at import / FAILED (errors=1) under discover
intact -> 10 OK; every probe restored byte-identical

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Shared surface (scripts/badf_gate.py) -> contract_changed by construction, so QA + REV, not ladder-internal. Ids swept with SARCHI's badf_id_sweep.py (#252, positive control PASS), ceiling WP-2026-0122/BADF-DEM-0108 printed beside the binding per BARCHI-1's rule, published on #211 before any edit, and ASKED -- BARCHI-1 and BARCHI-3 both confirmed clear, BARCHI-3 from their unpushed worktree, the surface no sweep can see. A filed acceptance criterion was found unbuildable and the deviation was posted to #211 before review rather than discovered at it. Reconciles WP-2026-0122; an earlier copy carried WP-2026-0117 which #258 landed first, so that copy collapsed byte-identically and was pruned in the same pass.

test_obligations.claim: a strict APPROVE ballot citing its own OPEN blocking finding is refused, while the conditional and rejecting arcs stay valid
